quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsui Chemicals semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-13-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Semi-annual report, first half April - September 2025: sales revenue fell 8.6% to JPY 813.6 billion on lower selling prices following the decline in naphtha and other raw material prices and lower Basic & Green Materials sales; core operating income fell 15.8% to JPY 44.5 billion on worse inventory valuation; operating income fell 39.3% to JPY 27.9 billion, also reflecting an impairment of the investment in an equity-method affiliate running a phenol business in China; net income attributable to owners of the parent fell 64.7% to JPY 7.8 billion. By segment, ICT Solutions core operating income rose on firm semiconductor and optical materials and ICT film and sheet sales as semiconductor market demand recovered, while Basic & Green Materials sales fell to JPY 295.6 billion and its core operating loss widened to JPY 10.5 billion.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 sales revenue JPY 813.6 billion (-8.6%); core operating income JPY 44.5 billion (-15.8%); operating income JPY 27.9 billion (-39.3%)
